core_A.idea: domino: three spinners in a row turn each other as they leave - the order of departures decides every direction

core_B.idea: parity key: the only purple key is an alternating spinner; it must leave after the right parity of turns to unlock

core_C.idea: count to two, not three: a pattern spinner (cw, cw, ccw) needs exactly two turns; the gate opens without turning it

core_D.idea: silent gate: the spinner beside the gate must leave through it unturned - any neighbour leaving first turns it into a deadlock

core_E.idea: pull away: a magnet pulls a spinner out of a neighbourhood whose departures would turn it the wrong way

core_G.idea: advances on a rhythm: two Sequence blocks advance next to a pattern spinner - each advance moves its cw-cw-ccw cycle on

core_H.idea: alternating chain: two adjacent alternating spinners turn each other back and forth

core_J.idea: pull into parity: a magnet pulls an alternating spinner into a three-neighbour slot - the parity of turns after the pull decides its exit
